wallet.create.title: Add a wallet
wallet.create.description: Connect a wallet you already own. 4Mica never asks for a seed phrase or private key.
wallet.create.fields.label.title: Name
wallet.create.fields.label.description: Only you see this. We've suggested one — change it if you like.
wallet.create.fields.description.title: Description
wallet.create.fields.description.descrip: Optional. What this wallet is used for.
wallet.create.fields.description.placeho: Receives settlement for the pricing API.
wallet.create.fields.role.title: Role
wallet.create.fields.role.description: Whether this wallet pays, receives, or does both.
wallet.create.verify.signHint: When you finish, your wallet will ask you to sign. Check the message names 4Mica and mentions wallet-link before you approve.
wallet.create.verify.noWallet: No browser wallet detected. Install one to continue.
wallet.create.verify.rejected: You dismissed the request, so nothing was added.
wallet.create.verify.connectFailed: Couldn't reach your wallet. Try again.
wallet.edit.title: Edit wallet
wallet.edit.description: Update how this wallet is labelled and used.
wallet.edit.immutable: On {{network}}. The address and network cannot be changed — link a new wallet instead.
wallet.edit.status.title: Status
wallet.edit.status.description: Pause a wallet to stop it being offered for new payments.
wallet.edit.status.retiredHint: This wallet is retired. Link the address again to bring it back.
wallet.delete.title: Remove this wallet?
wallet.delete.body: {{label}} ({{address}}) will no longer be available for payments.
wallet.delete.batchBody: {{count}} wallets will no longer be available for payments.
wallet.delete.hint: This removes the wallet from 4Mica only. Your funds and the address itself are untouched. Any API or agent that receives payments here is unpublished until you choose another wallet.
wallet.toolbar.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, description or address
wallet.empty.title: Add your first wallet
wallet.empty.description: A wallet is the address your agents pay from and your paywalls get paid to. Connect one you already own — it takes about thirty seconds.
wallet.empty.filteredDescription: Try a different search or clear the filters.
wallet.errors.addressInvalid: That is not a valid Ethereum address.
store.wallet.createdBody: You proved control of this address, so it can now receive payments.
store.wallet.deletedBody: It will no longer be offered as a payment destination.
store.wallet.noWallet: No browser wallet was detected. Install one to link an address.
store.wallet.rejected: You dismissed the signature request, so nothing was linked.
wallet.create.connect.title: Connect the wallet you want to use
wallet.create.connect.description: You will approve a connection, then sign a short message to prove the address is yours. Both are free and neither moves any funds.
wallet.create.connect.switchPrompt: 4Mica settles on these networks. Pick one and we'll switch your wallet over.
wallet.create.connect.alreadyLinked: This address is already added on this network. Pick another network above, or use Switch account to choose a different address in your wallet.
wallet.create.connect.safety: 4Mica is non-custodial: your keys stay in your wallet and we never take custody of your funds.
wallet.create.verify.switchRejected: You declined the network switch. Pick a network to continue.
wallet.create.verify.switchFailed: Couldn't switch network. Change it in your wallet and come back.
wallet.create.fields.network.mismatch: Your wallet is on {{wallet}} but this wallet will be saved for {{chosen}}. Signing still works, but balances and collateral live on {{chosen}}.
wallet.errorState.title: Couldn't load your wallets
store.wallet.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Refresh the page and sign in again.
wallet.create.connect.networkPrompt: A wallet is identified by its address and network, so the same address can be added once per network. Pick the network for this one.
wallet.create.verify.noAccounts: Your wallet didn't share an account. Unlock it or finish setting it up, then try again.
wallet.create.verify.getWallet: No wallet yet? Install one, then reload this page:
wallet.create.verify.sameAccount: Your wallet is still on this account. Choose another account in your wallet extension and it will update here.
